snippet.title: Might of Fate — Classic JRPG Adventure | Official Teaser
snippet.description:
Might of Fate — our new project is now on Steam! 🗡
It’s a classic-inspired JRPG where magic and humanity collide in a medieval world that plays by its own rules and doesn’t forgive mistakes.

You’ll follow Fate’s journey — from an ordinary guy to a warrior making choices alongside your allies and watching your destinies intertwine into one epic adventure.

We’ll showcase the first techno-demo version of the game exclusively at @latamgamescom!

Key features:

🔸 Turn-based combat
Equip the right weapons and head into battle. The combat system is built around stances — it’s not just about hitting harder, but switching at the right moment: Attacker, Defender, Slayer, Righteous — each stance is strong against one and vulnerable to another.

🔸 Open world & exploration
Explore the continent in search of secrets, chests, and story-driven quests. Discover the stories of strangers and companions, while the world evolves alongside your journey.

🔸 Skill tree
Each hero has a unique set of abilities. With every battle, your team gains experience, and with every level — skill points to unlock new powers.

🔸 Vivid storytelling
Cinematic cutscenes and realistic animations immerse you in the protagonist’s story from the very first moment.

“Does the world need magic — and is it worth saving?”

We’ll be sharing more development updates soon — for now, make sure to wishlist the game!
Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/4615970/Might_of_Fate/
Epic Games Store: https://store.epicgames.com/ru/p/might-of-fate-4b404f
